scope: Independent read-only review of inactive overlap accounting implementation; this record does not activate the pin, grant an allocation, change any provider setting, or claim a provider-enforced cap.
independent_checks: Read full guard and complete diff, certificate/review note, provider/sandbox evidence, overlap tests and mocked lifecycle tests.

Ran23 overlap tests and18 lifecycle tests, all PASS. Modal interfaces were mocked; writes were confined to temporary fixtures. No provider CLI/API call, allocation, real journal write or lock acquisition was made by this review.
Independently summed provider resource rows and per-App downward cent floors using Decimal.
Inspected runner creation of fresh ephemeral Apps and sandbox use, plus certificate binding of unique provider App IDs to the exact recorded sandboxes and reservations.

arithmetic.formula: 30 - 5 - max(all observed provider spend, certified highwater) - sum(all original and future reservations) + fixed3.74
arithmetic.bound: Each offset is no greater than posted attributed cost or its original reservation, and totalA<=Pmax. Accounted debitPmax+sumR-A remains at least sumR; unused reservation portions are never refunded.

findings.provider_inclusion: Saved hourly report starts at the exact billing cycle and reconciles the compute component within display rounding. Fresh exact-interval report must retain every saved row at equal/higher cost and fit within the current compute summary. Full current provider spend, other categories and historic highwater remain debited.
findings.attribution: Frozen certificate binds grant, nine-record journal prefix, run manifests and their exact credit receipts, original guard, worker/source hashes, terminated sandbox mappings and unique App IDs. Offset rows exclude unselected Apps, including unrelated/smoke usage.
findings.duplicate_credit: A is recomputed from fixed certified entries once per available-budget equation, never accumulated from prior receipts. Existing/new reservations are always charged in full. Duplicate object/environment/hour/resource identities and duplicate Apps are rejected; conflicting later certificate pins fail.
findings.revisions: Downward or missing billing rows fail closed; larger fresh costs cannot enlargeA. A certified App exceeding its original reservation also blocks. Declining aggregate totals cannot reducePmax.
findings.lock_and_crash: Original inode-based flock is retained from preflight through caller termination; no unlink/reset added. Reservation append+flush+fsync precedes yield/allocation. Missing manifests or unresolved termination block subsequent calls, and same-lock second process cannot reach provider calls.
findings.default_behavior: REVIEWED_OVERLAP_SHA256 remainsNone at review; old conservative budget behavior is retained without querying the report.
findings.future_reservations: Tests explicitly exercise repeated fixed offset with two full new debits, exhaustion on the next request, and future provider increases without additional offset.

limitations: Reservation rates,20% margin and build allowance are conservative estimates, not a contractual/provider spend cap; this change does not fix cost overruns.

The project lock and main-environment app check cannot prevent unrelated clients/hosts/environments from spending. Existing fresh workspace billing, termination checks and retained$5 headroom remain necessary; provider enforcement is a separate question.
Provider billing can be delayed or revised. Certificate proves observed overlap and guarded inclusion, not final settlement.
Manual pin activation changes the guard hash and must be recorded separately by root; future allocation must rerun all live preflight checks under the unchanged lock.
This review made no live provider query and does not replace root's fresh account evidence or execution-plan review.
